inheritanceRule: Every omitted field inherits the resolved Psychic parent value.

profiles.name: Amnesiac

evidence.reason: Repressed Memories / Spells / Spell Recollection defines the material change from the Psychic baseline.

profiles.playerSummary: The amnesiac once possessed great psychic power, but mental blocks—resulting from either a traumatic event or intentional implantation—have caused her to forget what she knew before
profiles.tradeoff: It replaces or alters Spellcasting; those base-class tools are exchanged for the archetype’s more specialised package.
